title: Little Briar Rose (The Thorn Castle)
summary: Enchanted by the uninvited thirteenth fairy to sleep for a century upon pricking her finger on a spindle, the royal maiden and the entire castle fell into motionless slumber....
full_text:
Enchanted by the uninvited thirteenth fairy to sleep for a century upon pricking her finger on a spindle, the royal maiden and the entire castle fell into motionless slumber.

A dense hedge of wild briar thorns covered the palace, defying all who tried to force entrance before the time was ripe.

When the hundred years expired, the thorns blossomed into fragrant red roses, parting willingly for the noble prince whose tender kiss awakened the sleeping princess and restored life, laughter, and love to the kingdom.
moral: The appointed hour of providence dissolves every barrier of thorn and sleep.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "Little Briar Rose"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
